# dsh-git-diff
Adds a **Git changes** tab to the right Sidebar of the DeepSeek Harness web UI (`dsh web`), next to
the built-in Files and Terminal tabs.

- Open it from the Sidebar guide. The header shows the current branch and how many paths changed.
-
Changed paths are listed with `M` / `A` / `D` / `R` / `C` / `T` / `U` (untracked) / `!` (conflict) b

adges. Paths that are already staged are marked.
- Expand a path to compare it side by side (see Dif
f view). Use the arrow button to open the file in the Sidebar preview; deleted paths have no such bu

tton.
- The list refreshes when the tab becomes visible, when an agent turn finishes, and on the Sid
ebar refresh command or button.
Version 1.x drew its own Files and History panels. DSH now ships both natively: the Files tab, and t
urn navigation in the chat. 2.0 therefore keeps only the git view and rebuilds it on the right-Sideb
ion in the chat. 2.0 therefore keeps only the git view and rebuilds it on the right-Sidebar tab API.
## Diff view
An expanded path shows two aligned columns: `HEAD` on the left, the working tree on the right.
- Each column has its own line numbers. Removed lines are red on the left, added lines are green on
the right, and a changed line faces its replacement. A line with no counterpart leaves a blank cell

on the other side.
- Three lines of context surround each change. Longer unchanged stretches fold in

to a single "N unchanged lines" row.
- A new or untracked file fills only the right column. A delete

d file fills only the left column.
- Long lines wrap inside their column, so the view fits a narrow

Sidebar.
- Binary files, and files where either side exceeds 512 KiB, show a note instead of a diff.
## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0` with the **web** profile.
- `git` on `PATH` in the Session'
s execution environment.
## Installation
The package is a DeepSeek Harness bundle. Its `cordis.patch.yml` registers one row, which loads both
the Host half (`lib/index.js`) and the browser half (`lib/client.js`).
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The built JavaScript in `lib/` is committed, so installation does not run a build. Reload the page a
fter installing. Remove the plugin with `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-git-diff`.
## Security
The plugin registers two read-only GET routes, `/api/dsh-git-diff/status` and `/api/dsh-git-diff/dif
f`, as exact Fetch routes on DSH's shared `/api` channel. Before a request reaches them, DSH's Conne
ction applies its Host/Origin trust checks and browser authentication, and only owner Peers get thro
n applies its Host/Origin trust checks and browser authentication, and only owner Peers get through.

- Each request names a Session. Git runs only in that Session's working directory.
- The diff route
returns content only for paths that `git status` currently reports as changed, and only inside the r
only for paths that `git status` currently reports as changed, and only inside the repository root.
## Development
[代码示例省略，未执行]
| Path | Role |

| `src/contract.ts` | Zod schemas for the wire responses, shared by both halves |
| `src/routes.ts`

| Route paths |
| `src/host/` | Host plugin: Session to working directory, git through `ctx.subproce

ss`, file reads through `ctx.fs` |
| `src/client/index.ts` | Browser plugin entry: tab type, guide e

ntry, tab body registration |
| `src/client/GitChangesBody.tsx` | Tab body: branch header, change li

st, per-path diff loading |
| `src/client/split-diff.ts` | Side-by-side row model: local patches fro

m `diff`, paired old/new lines, folded gaps |
| `src/client/SplitDiff.tsx` | Two-column diff rendere

r |
| `src/client/api.ts` | Browser adapter over the Host routes, parsed with the shared contract |

| `src/client/locales.ts` | English and Chinese dictionaries |
| `scripts/build.mjs` | esbuild: ESM
Host bundle and client bundle in the DSH module-loader envelope, with CSS-module styles injected |
The client bundle imports only from the Web shell's platform modules (`react`, `zod`, `@deepseek-ai/
dsh-client-ui-primitives`, and so on). Everything else, including `swr` and `diff`, is bundled. The
build fails when the client imports any other `@deepseek-ai/*` package at runtime.
